stories.title: Helicóptero com cantor Rick estava em encosta de mata densa: 'identificamos abertura na vegetação', diz bombeiro

en.title: Helicopter carrying singer Rick was on dense forest slope: 'we identified an opening in the vegetation', says firefighter
en.summary: A helicopter crashed in Urubici, Santa Catarina, killing five people including singer Rick. The aircraft was found on a densely forested slope after 13 hours of search operations by the Brazilian Air Force.

stories.title: Chuva forte atinge parte do Sudeste, e fumaça de queimadas avança pelo Norte; veja previsão

en.title: Heavy rain hits part of Southeast, and wildfire smoke advances through North; see forecast
en.summary: Brazil is experiencing heavy rainfall in parts of the Southeast while smoke from wildfires spreads across the North and Center-West regions. Cold temperatures are expected in the South and intense heat in interior areas.

stories.title: Meta lança óculos inteligentes sem câmera após reclamações por vídeos sem consentimento; veja como eles funcionam

en.title: Meta launches smart glasses without camera after complaints about videos recorded without consent; see how they work
en.summary: Meta unveiled new smart glasses including a camera-free model called Ray-Ban Meta Audio in response to privacy concerns. The device captures user voice during calls and enables hands-free music and podcast listening.

stories.title: Deserto colorido: Atacama floresce após volume de chuva inédito provocado pelo El Niño; veja fotos

en.title: Colorful desert: Atacama blooms after unprecedented rainfall triggered by El Niño; see photos
en.summary: The Atacama Desert is experiencing an unusual flowering event following record rainfall caused by El Niño weather patterns.

stories.title: Caixa-preta de helicóptero que caiu e causou morte de cantor Rick e outras 4 pessoas é localizada

en.title: Flight data recorder from helicopter crash that killed singer Rick and 4 others is located
en.summary: Authorities have recovered the flight data recorder from a helicopter that crashed in Santa Catarina, Brazil, killing singer Rick and four other people on board.

stories.title: Dona da Estácio e Afya se unem e criam gigante do ensino médico com receita de R$ 9 bi

en.title: Owner of Estácio and Afya merge to create medical education giant with 9 billion reais in revenue
en.summary: Yduqs and Afya announced a combination of their operations to create a major medical education provider with approximately 38,000 medical undergraduate students and nearly 5,900 authorized annual course openings.

stories.title: Avanço de Flávio Bolsonaro faz Lula reavaliar estratégia, e presidente deve ir a debate da Globo

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's advance prompts Lula to reconsider strategy; president expected to participate in Globo debate
en.summary: President Lula is reconsidering his previous plan to debate only in the second electoral round, now planning to participate in a Globo debate on Thursday following Flávio Bolsonaro's gains in opinion polls.

stories.title: Cenipa recupera caixa-preta de helicóptero que levava cantor Rick

en.title: Cenipa recovers flight data recorder from helicopter carrying singer Rick
en.summary: Brazil's aeronautical accident investigation center recovered the flight data recorder from a Bell 430 helicopter that crashed in Santa Catarina's Urubici region, killing singer Rick and four other occupants.

stories.title: Lula manobra para deixar investigação sobre Flávio Bolsonaro nas mãos de Dino e escapar de Mendonça

en.title: Lula maneuvers to leave investigation into Flávio Bolsonaro in Dino's hands and escape Mendonça
en.summary: President Lula is reportedly attempting to transfer an investigation concerning Flávio Bolsonaro to Justice Minister Dino's jurisdiction rather than another official.

stories.title: Yduqs e Afya fecham acordo para fusão e criam gigante do ensino superior em saúde

en.title: Yduqs and Afya close merger agreement and create giant in health education
en.summary: Two major Brazilian higher education companies announced a merger that will combine their medical and health-related educational programs into a larger entity.

stories.title: Dona da Estácio incorpora Afya e cria gigante do ensino médico no país

en.title: Estácio owner incorporates Afya and creates giant in medical education in the country
en.summary: Yduqs, owner of Estácio and Ibmec, merged with Afya to create a major medical education provider controlling approximately 38,000 undergraduate medical students and nearly 5,900 authorized annual course positions.

stories.title: Caixa-preta é localizada e vai para análise do Cenipa com dados do voo que matou Rick

en.title: Black box is located and will be analyzed by Cenipa with data from flight that killed Rick
en.summary: The flight data recorder from a helicopter that crashed in Santa Catarina, killing singer Rick Sollo and four others, has been recovered and will be sent to aviation authorities for investigation.

stories.title: Preço acessível torna a Geração Z americana receptiva a veículos elétricos e chips chineses

en.title: Affordable Price Makes American Generation Z Receptive to Electric Vehicles and Chinese Chips
en.summary: A Cox Automotive survey found that 69% of American Generation Z drivers would consider purchasing vehicles from Chinese manufacturers like BYD or Geely. Affordable pricing is a top priority for this demographic, as average new vehicle prices in the United States have risen to approximately $50,000.

stories.title: EUA e China concordam em prorrogar trégua comercial até janeiro, diz Bessent

en.title: US and China Agree to Extend Commercial Truce Until January, Says Bessent
en.summary: The United States and China have agreed to extend a commercial truce until January, according to US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. The extension aims to provide more time for negotiations on broader trade agreements amid ongoing tariffs and restrictions.

stories.title: Em evento no Rio, Lula faz apelo por maioria de esquerda no Senado: ‘Não temos mais idade pra brincar’

en.title: In Rio Event, Lula Calls for Left-Wing Majority in Senate: 'We're No Longer Young Enough to Play Games'
en.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated for left-wing parties to secure a Senate majority at an event in Rio de Janeiro. He referenced a cautionary example from Rio Grande do Norte where internal left divisions resulted in an opposing candidate's election.

stories.title: Afya e Yduqs confirmam fusão que cria companhia de R$ 9 bilhões

en.title: Afya and Yduqs Confirm Merger Creating R$ 9 Billion Company
en.summary: Afya and Yduqs completed a merger creating an educational company with net revenue of approximately R$ 9 billion. Afya will be the controlling shareholder with 69%, while Yduqs will hold 31% with rights to minimum dividends of R$ 750 million.

stories.title: Flávio propõe fim do regime de partilha do petróleo e detalha programa contra endividamento

en.title: Flávio proposes ending Brazil's oil production-sharing regime and details debt-reduction program
en.summary: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro signaled plans to change legislation to eliminate the production-sharing model for oil and natural gas exploration in Brazil, replacing current rules that apply to pre-sal areas and other strategic zones.
